_readme: APPEND-ONLY timestamped rate captures. Never edit or delete existing entries;
add new entries with a fresh capturedAtUtc to build a price history.
Every price below was read directly from the named source page at the captured
UTC time (corroborated by the source URL's own chal_t/srepoch epoch parameter).
No price in this file is estimated or remembered - if it is not on the source
page, it does not go in here.

method.source: Booking.com property page loaded with date parameters (checkin/checkout/group_adults/no_rooms/selected_currency=USD), free-cancellation context
method.captureRule: Room rows are copied verbatim: room name, bed count, per-night price, stay total, tax note, cancellation deadline text, prepayment text. 404 slug guesses and unverified rows are never recorded as data.
caveats: Rates are per rate-plan, not per hotel; they can change or sell out at any time after capture.
Prices are Booking.com's display conversion to USD, 'before taxes' unless the row says otherwise (most rows say 'Excluded: 10% TAX').
'Free cancellation before <date>' is the policy Booking displayed at capture time; the authoritative terms are those shown at checkout.
Official brand sites may show different prices/availability than Booking.com (e.g. a hotel 'not available' here may be bookable direct).

captures.finding: Seoul search with the Free cancellation filter returned 2,044 properties with free cancellation for Nov 1-9, 2026; the cheapest verified example card (Lake Tourist Hotel, Songpa-Gu, Double Room, free cancellation + no prepayment) showed $46/night, $365 total for 8 nights.
captures.note: Establishes that refundable inventory for these exact dates is plentiful on this source at capture time.
